he.label: עברית
he.subtitle: מענה ראש הממשלה לשאלות מבקר המדינה
he.heroLead: מה שאל מבקר המדינה ומה ענה ראש הממשלה. בתוך התשובות מובאים הדיונים הביטחוניים עצמם, כל דובר בלשונו.
he.proHead: אלה הדברים שנאמרו לראש הממשלה על חמאס. לכל אחד מהם התאריך שבו נאמר.
he.proNote: כל ציטוט בעמודים הבאים מופיע במסמך ואושר לפרסום בידי ראש הממשלה. הספירה מגיעה עד שבת בבוקר, 7 באוקטובר 2023.
he.oct7Line: שבת, 7 באוקטובר 2023. שיחת ווטסאפ מהמזכיר הצבאי מעדכנת את ראש הממשלה שהמתקפה החלה.
he.footer1: כל האמור לעיל הוא מענה ראש הממשלה לשאלות מבקר המדינה, כפי שהוגש בדצמבר 2025. המסמך מונה 55 עמודים ו־33 נספחים. חלקים שלא אושרו לפרסום מוצגים כמושחרים.
he.footer2: בדיקת האירועים טרם הושלמה. הדברים המובאים כאן הם טענות ועמדות של ראש הממשלה ושל הדוברים בדיונים, ולא קביעות של גוף בודק.
he.morning: בבוקר, כשעה ורבע לפני תחילת המתקפה
he.landLead: כאן נחשפים פרוטוקולים אמיתיים מן הדיונים שקדמו ל־7 באוקטובר ומאלה שבאו אחריו. האתר מוגש כשירות לציבור, שזכותו לדעת את האמת.
he.landSoonNote: שווה לחזור. כל פרסום חדש עולה לדף הזה.
he.landFoot: הדברים לקוחים מפרוטוקולים אמיתיים שנחשפו, ואחרים ייחשפו בהמשך. מוגש כשירות לציבור.
he.landNewsPull: לא הייתה שום שיחה, ולא הייתה שום התראה.
he.landNewsQuote: אין דבר כזה שיש שיחה כזאת בלי נציג של המל״ל או מישהו נוסף בחדר. אין מצב שאין לשיחה כזאת הקלטה.
he.landNewsAttr: בנימין נתניהו, בתגובה לפרסום שלפיו קיבל התראה ממוחמד בן זאיד לפני 7 באוקטובר
he.landNewsNote: לשיחה כזאת יש רישום, פרוטוקול והקלטה.
he.landBennettAttr: נפתלי בנט, בריאיון לגלי צה״ל, 8 בספטמבר 2026

en.label: English
en.subtitle: The Prime Minister's response to the State Comptroller's questions
en.heroLead: What the State Comptroller asked and what the Prime Minister answered. Inside those answers are the security consultations themselves, each speaker in their own words.
en.proHead: These are the things said to the Prime Minister about Hamas. Each carries the date it was said.
en.proNote: Every quotation on the pages that follow appears in the document and was cleared for publication by the Prime Minister. The count runs to Saturday morning, 7 October 2023.
en.oct7Line: Saturday, 7 October 2023. A WhatsApp call from the Military Secretary tells the Prime Minister the attack has begun.
en.speakersKicker: SPEAKERS · SELECT AS MANY AS YOU LIKE
en.footer1: Everything above is the Prime Minister's response to the State Comptroller's questions, as submitted in December 2025. The document runs to 55 pages and 33 appendices. Passages not cleared for publication are shown redacted.
en.footer2: The examination of these events is not complete. What appears here are the claims and positions of the Prime Minister and of the speakers in those consultations, not the findings of any investigating body.
en.morning: in the morning, about an hour and a quarter before the attack began
en.srcNote: Quotations are an unofficial translation from the Hebrew original. Hover a quotation to see the Hebrew as it appears in the document.

doc.מה היו הדירקטיבות שלך כראש ממשלה לרצועת: What were your directives as Prime Minister regarding the Gaza Strip in terms of defence, offence, containment and quiet?
doc.מדיניות ההסדרה - מה היו השיקולים האסטרטג: The 'arrangement' policy — what were the central strategic considerations in advancing the arrangement policy toward the Gaza Strip? How were its risks managed?
doc.אסטרטגיה - תאר את האסטרטגיה של מדינת ישר: Strategy — describe the State of Israel's strategy as you led it toward the Gaza Strip and Judea and Samaria, and the relationship between them
doc.עריפה - תאר את ההתפתחות לאורך השנים בקבל: Decapitation — describe the development over the years in decision-making on the killing of senior Hamas figures in the Gaza Strip, and the considerations that guided you in those decisions.
doc.האם כראש ממשלה אישרת את תפיסת ההגנה בגבו: As Prime Minister, did you approve the IDF's border defence concept across all arenas?
doc.חמאס מורתע - מה עמד בבסיס התפיסה / ההערכ: 'Hamas is deterred' — what underlay the concept or assessment that Hamas was deterred? Did you adopt that assessment?
doc.האם הדירקטיבה שגרסה כי חמאס מורתע ומעוני: Did the directive holding that Hamas was deterred and wanted quiet affect the attention given to defending the Gaza border? Did you require a periodic review of how far Hamas was deterred?
doc.מדוע לדעתך קיבל החמאס החלטה על המתקפה בש: In your view, why did Hamas decide on the attack of 7 October?
doc.האיום מרצ\"ע - כראש ממשלה, בהסתכלות לאחו: The threat from Gaza — as Prime Minister, looking back, how far were you party to the threats from Gaza? How did you understand the threat? Were you exposed to the 'Jericho Wall' document over the years?
doc.חומת יריחו - באפריל 2017 הנך מתבטא בוועד: Jericho Wall — in April 2017 you spoke before the State Control Committee about the threat from Gaza and described it in considerable detail. On what was that detail based? Were you aware of the Jericho Wall plan? If so, what were your instructions on the matter?
doc.ההפתעה - האם היו אינדיקציות או עדכונים ב: The surprise — were there indications or updates about Hamas preparing a surprise attack? In your view, how did the fact that Hamas was building up and training for a raid into Israel affect your assessment of the threat? Were warnings on the matter presented to you? Please elaborate
doc.תאר את מהלך האירועים בין 4 באוקטובר ל-7: Describe the course of events between 4 October and 7 October at 06:30 as you saw it
doc.מתקפת מנע - מדוע כראש ממשלה לא הנחית על: Pre-emptive strike — why, as Prime Minister, did you not order a pre-emptive strike in the north and the south in the period before 7 October, given the developing threats, and how does that square with the security doctrine you presented to us? And what are the lessons for the future?
doc.אילו החלטות של הדרג המדיני – רה\"מ ו/או: Which decisions of the political echelon — the Prime Minister and/or the cabinet — were taken on 7.10, and exactly when?
doc.מה היו ההנחיות של הדרג המדיני (רה\"מ ו/א: What were the political echelon’s instructions (the Prime Minister and/or the cabinet) on 7.10 as to how the fighting was to be conducted?
Describe your approach to allowing funds into Gaza.
doc.בראייתך מהן סיבות השורש לכישלון האסטרטגי: In your view, what are the root causes of the strategic failure of 7 October?
doc.ראש הממשלה סבור שזכות הציבור לדעת את האמ: The Prime Minister holds that the public has a right to know the truth about the events of 7 October and what preceded them. That requires disclosing his answers to the Comptroller to the general public, including central parts of security consultations and documents whose publication does no harm to state security.
doc.כל הציטוטים המובאים במסמך זה, אשר לקוחים: All the quotations in this document, taken from the stenograms (transcripts) of security consultations chaired by the Prime Minister, were cleared for publication by the Prime Minister.
doc.כל המסמכים הנוספים המוזכרים במסמך זה התק: All the further documents mentioned here were received through the Military Secretariat to the Prime Minister; the quotations from them were presented to the Foreign Affairs and Defence Committee and to the political-security cabinet, and were cleared for publication by the Prime Minister.
doc.החלקים המושחרים במסמך זה לא אושרו לפרסום: The redacted parts of this document were not cleared for publication by the Prime Minister, and will be presented, together with all the appendices, to the Subcommittee for Intelligence, Secret Services and Prisoners of War of the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defence Committee.
doc.המונחים \"הכלה\" ו\"שקט\" מעולם לא נכללו: The terms "containment" and "quiet" were never part of the Prime Minister's directive.
doc.החלופה של כיבוש הרצועה נבחנה פעמים רבות: The option of occupying the Strip was examined many times and rejected outright by the defence establishment for the following reasons: it would be a long and costly military undertaking causing many casualties, it would have neither domestic nor international legitimacy, and there is no alternative governing authority.
doc.במהלך מבצע 'צוק איתן' עלתה בקבינט סוגיית: During Operation Protective Edge the question of occupying the Strip came before the cabinet, and there was unanimous agreement not to put the matter to a vote. Quotations from the cabinet discussion of 27.07.2014 follow:
doc.... אנחנו נדון גם על כיבוש עזה וגם על צע: … we will discuss both the occupation of Gaza and preliminary steps that could bring you to occupying Gaza…
doc.רצינו לדעת, ואתם כל הזמן רוצים לדבר, על: We wanted to know — and you keep wanting to talk — about occupying Gaza… so let us finally see what …
doc.לא, לא, אני מעולם לא אמרתי \"כיבוש עזה\": No, no, I never said "occupying Gaza"…
doc.יש פה שאלה והיא תגיע באמת ליעד שלנו, מה: There is a question here, and it really comes down to our objective: what is our aim? Is our aim in fact to reach the demilitarisation of Gaza by force, which is the only guaranteed demilitarisation… In my view there is only one way to get that from him now, and that is to occupy him…
doc.אני חושב שכיבוש עזה והעיר עזה היא בליבת: I think occupying Gaza and Gaza City is well within the IDF's capability. You do not need to be much of a strategist to understand that it would be a grave mistake … I think it would be a mistake militarily, morally and generally …
doc....אני חושב שלכבוש את עזה זו תהיה שגיאה: …I think occupying Gaza would be a strategic error of the first order. I also think nobody around this table really wants it … I think it would be a strategic error … I really do not think we want to go anywhere near that.
doc.הצבא מסוגל לכבוש את עזה ... זה פשוט מיות: The army is capable of occupying Gaza … it is simply unnecessary at present…
doc.... נשאלת השאלה האם אנחנו צריכים ללכת למ: … the question arises whether we should go for a different course … that "something else" is called toppling Hamas … it is not right to take that course … I think it is not proper to take that course … I recommend that the cabinet not declare, or stop declaring, that we have no interest in occupying or toppling…
doc.זו גם הסיבה שלא רציתי לקיים את הדיון הזה: That is also why I did not want to hold this discussion until now, but now it is forced on us … unless there is a majority here for occupying Gaza…
Then do not put it to a vote, and everything is fine.
I will not put it to a vote.
doc....אני הייתי עושה את הניסיון. יש כאן מיש: …I would make the attempt. Is there a single person here who wants to occupy Gaza today?
doc.לא, אבל את לא רוצה –: No, but you do not want —
doc.אני דווקא בעד השאלה הזו, הייתי רוצה לדעת: I am actually in favour of that question; I would like to know… I think there will be unanimity here that nobody wants it…
doc.... אני מאד לא ממליץ לבצע שום מהלך קרקעי: … I strongly advise against any significant ground move … we will pay a high price and it is not certain we will achieve that gain…
…Tzipi asked earlier whether I am in favour of occupying Gaza. I was against it at the outset, I remain against it, I am against occupying Gaza — I simply will not say so outside, like everyone else. …I am not eager for battle. I am against "Spear", against occupation …
doc....אם אתה שואל אותי עמדתי היא שלא צריך ל: …If you ask me, my position is that no decision should be taken right now. There is an opportunity at present to wait and see who blinks, whether Hamas blinks —…
doc.אוקי. איוט. בקיצור ההצעה שלך היא לא להחל: Okay. Fine. In short, your proposal is not to decide and to wait?… I want to ask you whether at this moment there is anyone here proposing the occupation of Gaza or a large ground operation. That is what I am asking.
I am proposing neither occupation nor a ground incursion…
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official cabinet stenogram of 27.07.2014)
doc.לאור ההתנגדות הגורפת לכיבוש, בפועל מדיני: Given the sweeping opposition to occupation, the Prime Minister's policy in practice was to strike Hamas hard — a sustained 'mowing the grass'. This was already evident at the close of Operation Protective Edge, as the IDF withdrew, in the destruction of tunnels and the aerial pounding of Hamas, which dropped all its demands.
doc.גם בספטמבר 2016 עלתה בדיוני הקבינט שאלת: In September 2016 too the question of alternatives to the policy toward the Gaza Strip came up in cabinet discussions, and then too not a single party supported a full occupation of the Strip. From the Gaza situation assessment of 11.09.2016:
doc.... הדירקטיבה שקבע הקבינט בישיבתו האחרונ: … the directive the cabinet set at its last session in May: postponing the next round by two years… The first option is a limited operation… ending in some arrangement. The second is defeating the military wing… The third is a decisive move leading to the toppling of Hamas rule… Our recommendation is to stay with the directive… not to reach a military move… because the IDF presented a situation in which there are cross-border tunnels and a possibility that we will be strategically surprised…
doc....אנחנו לא חושבים שקיימת חלופה בטווח המ: …We do not think an alternative exists in the immediate term to Hamas government or rule, and therefore this means a return to military government for a period, with all the responsibility that entails. No such capacity exists today… this is a large-scale national project… very high costs…
doc....אתם מדברים כל הזמן על אופציה שלא קיימ: …You keep talking about an option that does not exist. I do not know of one person who supports it; it does not exist, nobody is proposing it. I do not know one person in the State of Israel who wants to return to military government in the Gaza Strip… There is no point discussing things that are not relevant… We are taking no responsibility whatsoever!
doc....הייתי בשלב הראשון הולך לתכנית שהתכלית: …At the first stage I would go for a plan whose purpose is weakening Hamas, and over time perhaps replacing Hamas…
doc.... כרגע אני רוצה למנוע את היכולת שלו לח: … Right now I want to deny him the ability to penetrate the communities, his whole plan. We are watching his plan right in front of our eyes…
doc.... נכון לרגע זה לחמאס אין אינטרס לצאת ל: … As of this moment Hamas has no interest in going to war… Hamas without an underground penetration capability is an entirely different Hamas. Hamas's ability to generate a significant surprise today lies solely underground… Without underground tunnels Hamas has no real ability to generate a threat to the State of Israel…
doc.... יש לו עוד דבר אחד... הם יכולים לקחת: … He has one more thing… they can take a million people and push them at the fences. That too is possible… that is in fact what they have… so either they penetrate underground or they send the masses streaming above ground…
There is the slurry wall and there is an above-ground barrier.
doc.גם ▮ [הכוונה למכשול העילי – ב.נ] לא שווה: ▮ [meaning the above-ground barrier — B.N.] is also worth nothing if they come in their tens of thousands…
doc.... לגבי החלופות לתקיפה. קודם כל אני לא: … As to the options for attack. First of all, I do not believe in wiping out Hamas; that is a story that does not add up…
doc.אם הרגתי את סנואר ואת צ'יף ואת כל המח\"ט: If I have killed Sinwar and Deif and all the brigade commanders, that whole crowd, does Hamas then collapse?…
doc.לא... החמאס לא מתמוטט אבל זה חמאס בסדר ג: No… Hamas does not collapse, but it is a Hamas of a different order of magnitude…
We can only do that in a surprise strike…
doc.נדב זו לא אמירה מן השפה אל החוץ, אני מתכ: Nadav, this is not lip service, I mean it — let us kill them if we have to… What about Sinwar?
doc.... אם יש לנו שבוע אז אנחנו נמצא גם את י: … If we have a week then we will find Yahya Sinwar too…
Clearly the priority is those two men… If you have no other corroborating sign, you say "do not do it"? That is what you are saying.
doc.... אירוע שבו חמאס רוצה לפתוח במלחמה ולא: … A scenario in which Hamas wants to start a war and we do not see it seems to me highly improbable… The conclusion is that we need to be very well prepared, but I do not think it is right to initiate…
doc.... אני גם לא חושב שאפשר למוטט את הזרוע: … I also do not think the military wing can be toppled. Hamas will remain and you will be left there in an enormous quagmire… An initiated war today is not necessary. If you deny them the tunnels… you have taken away their main card… I propose that the present situation — besieging, weakening, as far as possible — continue…
doc....יש לנו עדיפות מוחצת על חמאס, כך שאני: …We have overwhelming superiority over Hamas, so I suggest we not frighten ourselves… The State of Israel has a magnificent intelligence system. The expectation of Military Intelligence and of the Shin Bet is to provide warning… The order of battle along sixty kilometres is three times what is on the Golan Heights along a hundred and thirty… The slurry wall is a major challenge and there is no other solution… it is a two-year project… Is the achievement the toppling of Hamas rule? I think that by any route it is not right to topple a government… Bottom line: our policy on the use of force is the right policy…
… What do we want to achieve vis-à-vis the Gaza Strip… We must deny them a surprise capability… That is exactly the capability they are building on… to break forward… and seize one of the communities… The moment they understand that you have reached the point where you have closed off the slurry wall… that you have cancelled their main advantage, the tunnelling… the moment they see that it is genuinely real and effective and that we are uncovering tunnel after tunnel, it is clear to me beyond any doubt that they will not let it pass quietly…
doc.אני רוצה לשאול אותך שאלה מעשית... אני רו: I want to ask you a practical question… I want to understand whether you are saying that by the end of 2017, one way or another, we will be drawn into battle… Is that what you are saying?
doc.... ברגע שהם יבינו שאנחנו מנטרלים להם את: … The moment they understand that we are neutralising their tunnelling, at that moment we are at war.
doc....אנחנו צריכים לקבל את זה כהנחה... נגיד: …We have to take that as a premise… We will tell them there is no way we neutralise your tunnels while you come and we let you strike us… That message has to be conveyed to them… You need to be built for 14+… [meaning operational readiness to act within 14 days — B.N.] The central thing that must exist… we want to kill them, so be ready for it… In my view we will stop them from running… but if it turns out we were wrong, then be ready to take their heads off at a few hours' notice…
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official stenogram of the Gaza situation assessment of 11.09.2016)
doc.בדיון הנ\"ל ראש הממשלה נתניהו ושר הביטחו: In that discussion Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defence Minister Liberman warned of the danger of an above-ground invasion, which the security bodies determined was improbable. Three months later, on 21.12.2016, Liberman sent a letter to the defence establishment repeating the point. After the war broke out, Liberman leaked his letter to the media, claiming that he alone had warned of this danger.
doc.לאור ההתנגדות הגורפת לכיבוש, גובשה מדיני: Given the sweeping opposition to occupation, a policy was formed whose purpose was the constant 'mowing' of 'the grass' through intense actions and sustained operations — Pillar of Defence; Protective Edge; Black Belt; Guardian of the Walls; and Shield and Arrow. In addition, steps were taken to prevent build-up and to prevent the construction of transport infrastructure in the Strip, such as a seaport or an airport, through which terrorist organisations could smuggle weaponry.
doc.תחת מדיניות זו, בלט פער בין ראש הממשלה ל: Under this policy a gap stood out between the Prime Minister and the defence establishment over what mainly restrains Hamas: the Prime Minister emphasised deterrence and weakening, including by decapitating the enemy's leadership, while the defence establishment emphasised reaching understandings with Hamas that included civilian benefits, to increase the value of keeping the quiet.
doc.ביטוי לפער זה ניתן בדיון שקיים ראש הממשל: This gap found expression in a discussion held by the Prime Minister after Operation Guardian of the Walls, on 24.05.2021. From that discussion:
doc....יש שתי חלופות אב, החלופה הראשונה כרוכ: …There are two master options. The first involves toppling Hamas, and then you ask yourself what will take its place… The second is stabilising and maintaining the Strip under Hamas rule… but restrained, and restrained…
doc.יש לך יעד ביניים... במקום הכיבוש אתה יכו: You have an intermediate objective… Instead of occupation you can define these blows you deliver as blows to the regime — that is, you lop off the command layer, not just those two clowns [Sinwar and Deif — B.N.], but you actually make an enormous concentrated effort to be able to cut down a large leadership layer each time, so as to produce far stronger deterrence. That is, not only catching Deif or Sinwar during an operation… but cutting down the whole leadership spine, at a level of deterrence that is far more powerful and far cheaper.
doc.לא, או שתיתן מכות ותרתיע לאיזה שהיא תקופ: No — or you deliver blows and deter for some period. I say deterrence can be deterrence by mass decapitation: not a small decapitation and not of one man only, but mass decapitation…
doc....אפשרות אחת היא החיסול של סנואר בעדיפו: …One option is the killing of Sinwar as first priority and of Deif as second… If I could kill either of those two, I would go for it, because I think it also buys us deterrence in the north against that lunatic [Nasrallah — B.N.], who would learn not to be insolent. He would be afraid as well…
doc....אני אמרתי קודם ואני חוזר על עמדתי – א: …I said earlier and I repeat my position — if we go for Sinwar, in high probability that means a great many more days; I am firmly opposed…
…I too bear responsibility… I really am opposed to this…
doc.... אתה יכול להתנגד לזה וזה לגיטימי... א: … You may object and that is legitimate… if you have an objection that is fine… What I am telling you is also legitimate and in my view prevails. I think it never makes a difference to me… because the deterrent gain is enormous… I think we will not achieve deterrence without killing the leadership… and in the end we will get into the same thing and you will have further rounds…
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official stenogram of a security consultation on Gaza, 24.05.2021)
doc.המחשה לתפיסת מערכת הביטחון את החלופות למ: An illustration of how the defence establishment saw the policy options toward the Strip can be found in a broad analytical paper circulated by the Shin Bet on 27 October 2022, setting out the various policy options toward the Strip. The paper presented four policy options and recommendations:
doc.א. חלופת ההכרעה — ההמלצה: חלופה \"לא ריא: a. The decisive-victory option — recommendation: an "unrealistic" option.
doc.ב. חלופת ההתשה והחרפת הלחץ הכלכלי על חמא: b. The attrition option, intensifying economic pressure on Hamas — recommendation: an "inadvisable" option.
doc.ג. חלופת הבלימה - הקלת הלחץ הכלכלי על חמ: c. The containment option, easing economic pressure on Hamas — recommendation: the recommended option.
doc.ד. חלופת ההכלה - עיגון הבנות לטווח ארוך: d. The accommodation option, anchoring long-term understandings through an agreement — no recommendation was given.
doc.ארבעה ימים לפני מתקפת ה-7 באוקטובר, הפיץ: Four days before the attack of 7 October, Military Intelligence circulated a paper summarising insights on the annual assessment for 2023. The paper stated as follows:
doc.\"השאיפה המרכזית ברצ\"ע היא שמירה על הסט: "The central aspiration in the Gaza Strip is preserving the status quo of the security regime… That regime will continue to hold only through the granting of economic-civilian returns, and deterrence alone is not sufficient… The security regime needs to be fed with periodic rather than 'one-off' returns…"
doc.גם ביחס ליהודה ושומרון, מדיניות ראש הממש: With regard to Judea and Samaria too, the Prime Minister's policy rested on sustained strikes against terrorism. The Prime Minister sees no difference between Hamas and the Palestinian Authority as to the overriding aim of both, which denies the State of Israel's right to exist. The Prime Minister persisted in conducting the struggle in parallel, against terrorism in Judea and Samaria and against terrorism in Gaza alike.
doc.לאחר מבצע 'שומר החומות' בלטה סוגיית הכוו: After Operation Guardian of the Walls, the issue of Hamas directing terrorist activity in Judea and Samaria and inside Israel from Gaza came to the fore. The Prime Minister emphasised punitive and deterrent measures against Hamas in Gaza, including the targeted killing of senior figures, while the defence establishment emphasised the use of threats and civilian sanctions.
doc.להלן מתוך פגישת עבודה בין ראש הממשלה לר': From a working meeting between the Prime Minister and the Head of the Shin Bet, Ronen Bar, on 31.07.2023:
doc.... עשיתי לך פה השוואה על היקף ההתרעות [: … I have made you a comparison here of the volume of warnings [in Judea and Samaria — B.N.]… this is 2021 and this is now… On any given day we are handling on average ▮ warnings… You can see the rise in cross-regional direction, most of it from Gaza…
They need to be hit hard. Kill someone there.
doc.סיכמתי עם הרמטכ\"ל ושהב\"ט שאנחנו מעבירי: I agreed with the Chief of the General Staff and the Defence Minister that we would pass them a message through the covert channel, probably this week, to Sinwar, that we are going to start playing with the workers shortly. After that there will be the workers, and we are preparing a low-signature operation.
Someone there needs to be killed.
doc.אנחנו מכינים את זה. אבל אתה צריך להיות ע: We are preparing that. But you have to be ready for a round of fighting. For that you must prepare for a round of fighting.
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official stenogram of a working meeting with the Head of the Shin Bet, 31.07.2023)
doc.ראש הממשלה צידד מאז ומתמיד בסיכולים ממוק: The Prime Minister has always favoured targeted killings as an effective instrument of deterrence. The following targeted killings were carried out in the Gaza Strip under his direction and with his approval:
doc.א. חיסול ראש הזרוע הצבאית של חמאס, אחמד: a. The killing of the head of Hamas's military wing, Ahmed Jabari, in November 2012, in the move that opened Operation Pillar of Defence.
doc.ב. חיסול סדרת בכירי חמאס במסגרת מבצע 'צו: b. The killing of a series of senior Hamas figures during Operation Protective Edge, in August 2014: the Hamas Rafah brigade commander Raed al-Attar, the Hamas southern area commander Mohammed Abu Shamala, and the senior Hamas smuggling and logistics figure Mohammed Barhoum.
doc.ג. חיסול בכיר בזרוע הצבאית של חמאס ואחרא: c. The killing of a senior figure in Hamas's military wing responsible for directing terrorist activity, Mazen Fuqaha, in March 2017.
doc.ד. חיסול בכיר בזרוע הצבאית של חמאס, נור: d. The killing of a senior figure in Hamas's military wing, Nour Baraka, in November 2018.
doc.ה. חיסול מפקד החטיבה הצפונית של גא\"פ בע: e. The killing of the commander of Islamic Jihad's northern brigade in Gaza, Baha Abu al-Ata, in November 2019, in the move that opened Operation Black Belt.
doc.ו. ניסיון חיסול של בכיר גא\"פ בסוריה אכר: f. The attempted killing of the senior Islamic Jihad figure in Syria, Akram Ajouri, in November 2019.
doc.ז. חיסול סדרת בכירי חמאס במבצע 'שומר החו: g. The killing of a series of senior Hamas figures in Operation Guardian of the Walls in May 2021 — the Gaza brigade commander Bassem Issa, the head of the research and development array Jamal Zabeida, the head of the technological intelligence array Sami Radwan and others.
doc.ח. ניסיון חיסול צ'יף במאי 2021 במסגרת מב: h. The attempted killing of Deif in May 2021 during Operation Guardian of the Walls.
doc.ט. חיסול פעילים בתשתית חמאס ביהו\"ש במחצ: i. The killing of operatives in the Hamas infrastructure in Judea and Samaria during the first half of 2023.
doc.י. חיסול צמרת גא\"פ במסגרת מבצע 'מגן וחץ: j. The killing of the Islamic Jihad leadership during Operation Shield and Arrow in May 2023.
doc.בימיו האחרונים של מבצע 'שומר החומות', כא: In the final days of Operation Guardian of the Walls, when the heads of the defence establishment recommended ending the operation and reaching understandings with Hamas, the Prime Minister insisted on continuing the campaign for at least a few more days in a further attempt to kill the head of the military wing, Mohammed Deif. The heads of the defence establishment opposed extending the campaign, and some argued that Deif was not a worthwhile target.
doc.ראש הממשלה עמד על כך שהמערכה תתארך ואכן: The Prime Minister insisted that the campaign be extended, and an attempt to kill Mohammed Deif was indeed carried out on 20 May, which failed.
doc.להלן מתוך חיתוך מצב 'שומר החומות' בראשות: From the Guardian of the Walls situation review chaired by the Prime Minister on 18.05.2021:
doc.... אתה רואה שאנחנו עושים את זה [סיכול צ: … Do you see us doing that [killing Deif — B.N.] after a ceasefire?
doc.... זו תהיה שגיאה ללכת על צ'יף ואז להישא: … It would be a mistake to go for Deif and then be left with Sinwar… I really am opposed to it… in my view it would be a grave mistake.
doc.זו לא תהיה שגיאה חמורה להוריד את צ'יף עכ: It would not be a grave mistake to take Deif down now.
Deif has become a soldier, pure and simple… that is all…
doc.... צריך לתת לנדב [ר' השב\"כ – ב.נ] לפחו: … Nadav [the Head of the Shin Bet — B.N.] should be given at least the next twenty-four hours to try to carry it out…
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official stenogram of the Guardian of the Walls situation review of 18.05.2021)
doc.להלן מתוך חיתוך מצב 'שומר החומות' שהתקיי: From the Guardian of the Walls situation review held the following day, on 19.05.2021:
doc.קודם כל השיחה שלי [עם הנשיא ביידן – ב.נ]: First of all my call [with President Biden — B.N.]… I told him we need another 48 hours [before a ceasefire — B.N.] to exhaust the possibility of killing the man who generates and commands the forces… I told him I think it changes the face of the campaign… He said it is difficult, that he is under pressure…
…You have tomorrow and the day after.
doc.... זה דבר חדש, לא על זה דיברנו!: … This is something new, that is not what we discussed!
doc.חד משמעית אמרתי שאני רוצה –: I said unequivocally that I want —
We unequivocally did not discuss that.
doc.אני אמרתי שאני אחלץ מביידן, ואתם רואים ש: I said I would extract it from Biden, and you can see that I did… Now I ask: is Deif worth this extra day to us? The answer is unequivocally yes. To my mind there is no question at all…
doc.אתה אומר שהגאנט הזה יכול למשוך לתוך יום: Are you saying this Gantt can stretch into Friday? Is that what you are saying?…
doc.אז אני אומר שאנחנו צריכים לעצור את המערכ: So I say we should stop the campaign. We should have stopped, and we are being dragged on and on and on.
doc.אני אשיב לזה... ואני חושב שאני מדבר בהגי: I will answer that… and I think I am speaking in pure logic… about the price of this campaign and about deterring the next one… The conclusion is simple: if you think Deif is a worthwhile target — and to my mind he is supremely worthwhile, giving us years of deterrence — even if it costs some temporary escalation…
doc.(ציטוטים שאישר ראש הממשלה לפרסם מתוך הסט: (Quotations the Prime Minister cleared for publication from the official stenogram of the Guardian of the Walls situation review of 19.05.2021)
doc.כאמור, לאחר שראש הממשלה עמד על כך שהמערכ: As noted, after the Prime Minister insisted that the campaign be extended, an attempt to kill Mohammed Deif was carried out on 20 May, which failed.
doc.בשנת 2023 הנחה ראש הממשלה לקדם את סיכול: In 2023 the Prime Minister directed that the killing of the Hamas leadership be advanced:
doc.א. ראש הממשלה הורה לראש השב\"כ ב-8 בינוא: a. On 8 January 2023 the Prime Minister instructed the Head of the Shin Bet to advance the killing of the commander of Hamas's military wing in Judea and Samaria, Saleh al-Arouri (who was in Lebanon); however the Head of the Shin Bet replied:
doc.\"זה לקחת את השב\"כ למקום מורכב, אני לא: "That would take the Shin Bet to a complicated place; I do not think it is right."
doc.ב. בדיון שהתקיים בראשות ר' השב\"כ בתאריך: b. At a discussion chaired by the Head of the Shin Bet on 5 April 2023, he recommended that
doc.\"לאור משמעויות של מימוש \"לוח הכפל\" (ס: "Given the implications of carrying out the 'multiplication table' (killing Sinwar and Deif) and the fact that we do not want to be dragged into a round, we must find a target… below the escalation threshold."
doc.ג. בדיון הערכת מצב ב-2 במאי 2023, בעקבות: c. At a situation assessment on 2 May 2023, following Islamic Jihad rocket fire at Israel, the heads of the defence establishment recommended responding against Islamic Jihad targets only. The Prime Minister ordered a forceful response that would send a deterrent message to the whole region, and asked those present whether there was readiness to kill the Hamas leadership. The Deputy Head of the Shin Bet and the Head of Military Intelligence replied that there was no such readiness at present.
doc.ד. בפגישת עבודה שקיים ראש הממשלה עם ר' ה: d. At a working meeting the Prime Minister held with the Head of the Shin Bet on 31 July 2023, he ordered immediate preparation to kill a senior Hamas figure in Gaza as a warning against the direction of terrorist activity. In response the Head of the Shin Bet noted that he had agreed with the Chief of the General Staff and the Defence Minister to make do for now with a message to Sinwar threatening to cut the number of workers. The Prime Minister repeated in response that "someone there needs to be killed", even at the price of escalation.
doc.לאורך שנת 2023 ראשי מערכת הביטחון לא הצי: Throughout 2023 the heads of the defence establishment did not present operational ripeness for killing the Hamas leadership in Gaza. Even so, the Prime Minister repeatedly directed that preparations be made for it, including a few days before the raid Hamas carried out on 07.10.23. From the Prime Minister's summing-up at the situation assessment of 01.10.2023, six days before the Hamas raid:
doc.בעזה, חד משמעית, האקורדיון הזה של ענישה: In Gaza, unequivocally, this accordion of punishment and retribution and civilian dialogue is acceptable. I think it is worth doing and worth bringing the direction of terrorism into the discussion, but also being ready there for the killing of one figure or a decapitation… That is the intent in Gaza: to reach some order of bringing things down, tying up the direction of terrorism, but if required, then action against a head and against heads, against the West Bank headquarters, and more than that if need be…
doc.ראש הממשלה מתווה את מדיניות ההגנה ביחס ל: The Prime Minister sets defence policy in relation to the threats presented to him. Against the threat of cross-border tunnels, presented as the central threat from Gaza, the Prime Minister insisted on building the underground barrier around the Gaza Strip (the slurry wall), which to this day has not been breached.
doc.ראש הממשלה אף זכה על כך לתשבחות משר הביט: For this the Prime Minister was even praised by the former Defence Minister, Gantz, at the ceremony inaugurating the completed barrier in December 2021. At the ceremony Gantz thanked Prime Minister Netanyahu —
doc.\"שהכיר בחשיבות הפרויקט - לא רק בפן המבצ: "who recognised the importance of the project — not only operationally but also for national resilience. He deserves great credit for a strategic undertaking of the first order."
doc.ביחס למכשול העילי ברצועה, מערכת הביטחון: As to the above-ground barrier along the Strip, the defence establishment presented it to the Prime Minister as effective against a ground raid.
doc.ב-7 באוקטובר 2021, שנתיים בדיוק לפני הפש: On 7 October 2021, exactly two years before the raid, the Gaza Division circulated a document titled "The Iron Wall — the routine defence concept in the Gaza Strip". From that document:
doc.קרקע - לאורך השנים האחרונות השתנה ושופר:
Ground — over recent years the defensive barrier on the Gaza Strip border has changed and improved significantly:
a. The intelligence grip and the ability to give warning of an attack have improved significantly.
b. Collection capabilities ▮ have significantly strengthened our ability to identify an approaching enemy.
c. The fence ▮, which is proving highly reliable, serves as a further line of defence against an attempted above-ground penetration.
doc.ד. הקמת מערכת מכשול תת קרקעי המשלבת טכנו:
d. The construction of an underground barrier system combining varied technology with a physical obstacle creates great difficulty for the enemy in penetrating past the 'hourglass' line into our territory.
e. The construction of the 'hourglass' fence — both a massive obstacle that is extremely hard to cross and a ▮ fence — adds a layer of physical blocking of a kind that did not yet exist on the Gaza Strip border, and makes it harder for the enemy to cross in routine and in emergency.

For more than four years no infiltrator has crossed the Gaza Strip border without the system giving warning of it!

Enemy capabilities:

3. The threat of a raid against Israeli communities and army camps is defined as a dangerous course of action. That this course of action is less probable stems from the low capability of the small organisations and from a conscious choice by Hamas and Islamic Jihad not to adopt such a course of action as a matter of routine…

5. The substantial barrier that has been built, and the challenge it poses to attempts to penetrate into Israel, make carrying out the raid course of action in routine even harder and reduce its probability…
doc.להלן מתוך דיון הקבינט על בניית המכשול הת: From the cabinet discussion on building the underground barrier, 10.03.2016:
doc....אנחנו מאוד מאוד ממוקדים בשנים האחרונו: …In recent years we have been very, very focused on the tunnel danger… We are ignoring a far greater danger… We are not focusing on a possibility that definitely exists, of a breakout above ground into our territory… Such a breakout is possible with relatively light means and could even be on a wider scale… Above ground there is no wall preventing this.
doc.... התפרצות כזאת על פני השטח היא אפשרית,: … Such a breakout above ground is possible; what is the remedy for it?… In my assessment that above-ground fence will not be strong enough to prevent its being blown apart by heavy trucks or by a large quantity of explosives, and blown apart at several points simultaneously.
doc.... יש טנקים סביב העוטף, יש כוחות, יש תש: … There are tanks around the Gaza envelope, there are forces, there is infrastructure, there is everything. And an "hourglass" is going to be built… because above ground we detect them.
doc.אז שתדע שיש חומת ברזל של שמונה מטרים, את: So you should know there is an eight-metre iron wall — you have seen it. It is not a block wall but an iron wall that does not allow anti-tank fire through it, that makes firing very difficult because the density and the volume of iron are very great. It is no less resistant than a wall… There is a solution that is both a ▮ fence and an "hourglass" fence, an eight-metre iron wall that is very hard to penetrate and very hard to cross. There is ▮, there is collection, there are forces… So it is right to manage risks and not to put billions into building a wall there… I think the answer given over the years is a good answer…
doc.כפי שהומחש, מערכת הביטחון הבהירה לראש המ: As illustrated, the defence establishment made clear to the Prime Minister that the existing above-ground barrier in Gaza, combined with the deployment of territorial forces, gave a complete answer to the threat of an above-ground raid.
doc.בדיון שקיים הרמטכ\"ל חודש לפני ה-7 באוקט: At a discussion held by the Chief of the General Staff a month before 7 October, on 7 September 2023, it was expressly determined that it was not right to invest further costs in defending the Gaza border. In the words of the summary:
doc.\"...הרמטכ\"ל הדגיש כי הסלמה מול רצ\"ע ע: "…The Chief of the General Staff stressed that escalation vis-à-vis the Gaza Strip might involve inputs, chiefly defence costs, which it is not right to invest at the present time."
doc.שלושה ימים לאחר מכן, ב-10 בספטמבר 2023,: Three days later, on 10 September 2023, the Prime Minister held a preparedness discussion ahead of the Tishrei holidays of 2023, in which the IDF presented that Hamas might stir up protests at the fence and noted that the IDF was arrayed for defence and for attack across all arenas. The circulated summary of the discussion recorded a clear directive from the Prime Minister:
doc.\"ראש הממשלה הנחה על המשך ההיערכות המבצע: "The Prime Minister directed the continuation of operational preparedness across all the security bodies as presented — an intelligence effort, force-reinforcement efforts, a defensive effort, and pre-emptive interdiction and warning efforts."
doc.האמירה ש\"חמאס מורתע\" לא היתה \"דירקטיב: The statement that "Hamas is deterred" was not a "directive" but the unified intelligence assessment supported by all of Israel's intelligence bodies, in documents, in discussions and in working meetings with the Prime Minister and with senior members of the political echelon.
doc.בחינה עיתית של מורתעות חמאס התקיימה למעש: A periodic review of how far Hamas was deterred in fact took place at every discussion dealing with the Palestinian arena, including a few days before 7 October 2023.
doc.במחצית הראשונה של שנת 2023, בצל המחלוקות: In the first half of 2023, against the backdrop of Israel's internal disputes, the understanding sharpened at the political and security levels that Israeli deterrence had eroded. The Prime Minister raised this issue and directed that measures be advanced to restore and strengthen deterrence, as will be illustrated below.
doc.על אף האמור, במהלך כל שנת 2023, ראשי מער: Notwithstanding the above, throughout 2023 the heads of the defence and intelligence establishment determined uniformly and consistently that Hamas was deterred and had no interest in a confrontation with Israel.
doc.להלן מתוך דיון קבינט מיום 12 בפברואר 202: From the cabinet discussion of 12 February 2023 on the security situation ahead of Ramadan:
doc.... עדיין סנואר דבק באסטרטגיה שלא להכניס: … Sinwar still adheres to the strategy of not drawing Gaza into the war. … Hamas does not think now is the right time for it to enter a campaign against Israel.
doc....יש לי קצת ניסיון... היינו בכמה וכמה מ: …I have a little experience… We have been in quite a few cases where Hamas had no interest at all in a campaign with us and was dragged in as a result of things that gradually escalated the atmosphere in the Palestinian and Gazan street…
doc....אני רואה את דרך החשיבה של סנואר שהוא: …I see Sinwar's way of thinking: he is trying to do the maximum that will not ignite too much and the minimum that will show he is still relevant…
doc....בחדר הזה עכשיו בעזה אצל סנואר אין שום: …In that room now in Gaza, with Sinwar, there is no reason at all to change anything. First of all, by Sheikh Yassin's theory they work in quanta of a desert generation, of forty years — meaning that from '87 they have to wait until 2027 to complete the generation of the era and go out to their campaign, so they still have time… Another thing: Yahya Sinwar is a sober leader; he is not ready for that war of revival…
doc.חמאס בעזה איבד חלק ניכר מיכולותיו כתוצאה: Hamas in Gaza has lost a considerable part of its capabilities as a result of our activity over the years. It once could do many things — for example go by sea routes, pass through tunnels, break out in above-ground actions… None of those are open to it, and the only avenue left to it is rocket fire, and it is in a situation where 95% of that is intercepted when it comes at Israel…
doc.במסגרת ההבנה כי הרתעת ישראל נשחקה, בלטו: Within the understanding that Israeli deterrence had eroded, papers of the Military Intelligence research division circulated in 2023 stood out, arguing that Israel's enemies discern Israel's present weakness. Across those papers it was presented that the erosion of deterrence might bear on a confrontation with Iran or in the north, while as to Hamas it was determined that it was deterred, had no interest in a confrontation with Israel, and was working to keep the Strip stable in the long term. Moreover, it was recommended to grant Hamas extensive benefits, including funds and infrastructure rehabilitation, as a tool for preventing escalation.
doc.להלן פירוט האמירות מתוך המסמכים:: The statements from those papers are set out below:
doc.א. במסמך שהופץ ב-19 במרץ 2023 נקבע כי המ: a. A paper circulated on 19 March 2023 determined that Israel's internal crisis actually removes any need for Hamas to advance action from Gaza. In the words of the paper:
doc.\"חמאס מזהה את המשבר הפנימי כהזדמנות שמת: "Hamas discerns the internal crisis as an opportunity that validates and reinforces its policy… worsening the security situation in Israel while leaving the Gaza Strip on a back slope."
doc.ב. במסמך שהופץ ב-28 במרץ 2023 פורטו ההשל: b. A paper circulated on 28 March 2023 set out the possible implications of the erosion of Israeli deterrence, but contained no reference at all to Gaza or to Hamas.
doc.ג. במסמך שהופץ ב-31 במאי 2023 נכתב כך:: c. A paper circulated on 31 May 2023 stated as follows:
"The Palestinian story, in which Hamas draws closer to the axis… and looks for new arenas of resistance, in view of its wish to keep the Gaza Strip stable…"
doc.ובמסמך הומלץ כך:: And the paper recommended as follows:
doc.\"להצטרף לטרנד הדה-אסקלציה: ... ניתן לקח: "To join the de-escalation trend: … a step forward can be taken in the arrangement with the Strip and the Hamas sovereign (diversifying and strengthening civilian instruments, long-term infrastructure projects, growing economic involvement by additional actors) in order to improve and stabilise the security regime formed after Guardian of the Walls."
doc.ד. במסמך שהופץ ב-23 ביולי 2023 לא מופיע: d. A paper circulated on 23 July 2023 contains no scenario at all of escalation from the Gaza Strip, and even stated that
doc.\"בשלב זה הסכנה הברורה והמיידית טמונה לה: "At this stage the clear and immediate danger lies, as I understand it, in escalation, chiefly in the Lebanese arena…"
doc.גם במסמך השב\"כ מ-02.02.2023, נטען כי הש: The Shin Bet paper of 02.02.2023 likewise argued that the erosion of deterrence presents Hamas with an opportunity to set Judea and Samaria alight, while in Gaza it might at most lead to a response to Israeli strikes. Thus:
doc.\"...חמאס וגא\"פ שבעי רצון מההידרדרות בי: "…Hamas and Islamic Jihad are well satisfied with the deterioration in Judea and Samaria, which in their view reflects a growing opportunity to set the arenas alight and to topple 'the Authority'. In parallel, their threshold of tolerance in the Strip is being eroded and the probability of a military move on their part is rising. This, in response to what they perceive as the 'disproportionality' of Israeli strikes in the Strip (in response to the rocket fire)…"
doc.ראש הממשלה היה שותף לתובנה כי חלה שחיקה: The Prime Minister shared the insight that Israeli deterrence had eroded and acted to strengthen it. From the Prime Minister's summing-up to the cabinet of 6 April 2023:
doc.א. ראש הממשלה ציין כי היעד המרכזי שלנו ה:
a. The Prime Minister noted that our central objective is to restore Israel's deterrent capacity across the various arenas, without deteriorating into escalation to war.
b. The Prime Minister recommends that the cabinet approve — striking Hamas targets in Gaza; striking targets in Lebanon… preparing personal Hamas targets abroad.
c. The Prime Minister ordered heightened readiness of the active defence array.
d. The Prime Minister directed that the cabinet convene as soon as possible in order to go deeper into the plans, the capabilities and the defence establishment's readiness for a campaign in the northern arena.
doc.במאי 2023 הנחה ראש הממשלה על מבצע 'מגן ו: In May 2023 the Prime Minister directed Operation Shield and Arrow, after Islamic Jihad fired rockets at Israel with Hamas's approval. From the Shield and Arrow situation assessment of 2 May 2023:
doc....העדיפות הראשונה היא ללכת על סיכול ממו: …The first priority is to go for targeted killing within Islamic Jihad… That somewhat misses making Hamas pay the price for having given cover… There is an option to do both; I do not think that is right…
doc.... צריך לחסל בכיר בגא\"פ ואז להמשיך לחמ: … A senior Islamic Jihad figure should be killed and then we move on to Hamas…
…I think we are in an even broader test… There is an assessment on their side — I mean with Hezbollah, Assad, the Iranians, Hamas and Islamic Jihad — that we are deterred. Our deterrence has been damaged, and this is not only a duty, it is also an opportunity to repair it… Here the price is a round, possibly a prolonged round; we can restore deterrence. That deterrence is called for on account of this incident too… And I would like to ask you a question: do you have Mohammed Deif?
doc....זה לא מוכן עדיין, אני לא יודע להבטיח: …It is not ready yet; I cannot promise you that.
doc....אתם צריכים להוסיף ולהוסיף באופן משמעו: …You need to add and add significantly, to be ready for a prolonged round… We cannot allow what is setting in across three hundred and sixty degrees to keep setting in. We need to make a change in the compass, and we have no better opportunity than Islamic Jihad and Hamas.
doc.בתור אחד שגם קורא את המודיעין, אני דווקא: As someone who also reads the intelligence, my impression is actually somewhat different… In my view this is far from a significant blow to Israeli deterrence vis-à-vis the arenas you mentioned. That is how I see it.
doc.אני רואה את זה אחרת. אני חושב שיש שם שחי: I see it differently. I think there is erosion there… We have to look at it squarely and tell the truth — there is erosion, there is a decline… And if they have any doubt, let us remove the doubt. Let us tell them: no, there is none here… I want "the landlord has gone mad"… We want to signal: this far and no further! And that is this far and no further… A far more forceful response is required here… Where is Sinwar?…
He has not come out at all.
doc.אבל אני חייב לציין שמכל האויבים שלנו בחו: But I must note that of all our enemies over the past month, the Hamas leadership of the Strip is the most deterred, the most convenient for us—
doc.אדרבה. אז אם כך, אדרבה. אני לא אומר לכם: All the more so. Well then, all the more so. I am not telling you otherwise. The ideal situation is truly to take the initiative, there is no doubt about that, but the chance that we will take the initiative is lower. Something always gets in the way; there is an inertia of quiet that paralyses — we know it. Here they have given us the blow… In my view we have no choice but to respond forcefully…
doc.במסגרת מבצע 'מגן וחץ' סוכלו בין היתר - ח: In Operation Shield and Arrow the following, among others, were killed: Khalil Bahtini, Islamic Jihad northern area commander; Tareq Izz al-Din, a senior Islamic Jihad figure; Jihad Ghannam, secretary of the Islamic Jihad military council; Ahmed Abu Daqqa, a senior figure in the Islamic Jihad rocket array; and Raad al-Husseini, head of the Islamic Jihad operations department. Following the operation:
doc.א. שר הביטחון בסיכום למבצע 'מגן וחץ' מ-1: a. The Defence Minister, in the summary of Operation Shield and Arrow of 18 May 2023:
doc.\"...ההרתעה סייעה להותרת חמאס מחוץ למערכ: "…Deterrence helped keep Hamas out of the campaign. There is now an opportunity to shape different reciprocal relations with Hamas, establishing a prolonged period of quiet… The demonstration of Israel's capabilities and its achievements also filtered through to other enemies, and raised Israel's standing before its friends…"
doc.ב. הרמטכ\"ל הרצי הלוי בהערכת מצב בראשות: b. The Chief of the General Staff, Herzi Halevi, at a situation assessment chaired by the Prime Minister on 4 June 2023:
doc.\"...אני חושב שההרתעה של מדינת ישראל היא: "…I think the State of Israel's deterrence is very much in force, very strong; we see these signs in the material…"
doc.עד לסוף תקופת החגים (תחילת יוני) – יש לפ:
Until the end of the holiday period (early June) — action should be taken to cool the arenas…
At the end of that period, and once the probability of multi-arena escalation has declined… it will be possible to turn to root treatment of the challenging actors, one arena at a time…
"Passing messages to Hamas through mediation channels that Israel is not seeking escalation, but that in the event of deterioration Hamas will pay dearly…"
doc.בסיכום דיון הקבינט שהתקיים ב-9 ביולי 202: In the summary of the cabinet discussion held on 9 July 2023, the Prime Minister repeated his instruction to the defence establishment to prepare for a multi-arena campaign scenario:
doc.\"ראש הממשלה ציין את הדירקטיבה שניתנה למ: "The Prime Minister noted the directive given to the defence establishment some time ago to prepare for a multi-arena scenario, including Iran and its proxies…"
doc.בחודשים הסמוכים ל-7 באוקטובר המשיכה מערכ: In the months immediately before 7 October the defence establishment continued to transmit intelligence papers determining that Hamas was deterred, had no interest in escalation, and sought to maintain the "policy of quiet" toward Israel.
doc.יתרה מזאת אף נקבע ברצף מסמכים כי המחלוקו: Moreover, a succession of papers determined that the internal disputes in Israeli society constituted a restraining factor for Hamas, and not the reverse.
doc.\"המצב הפנימי בישראל: מעצב מרכזי בהערכת: "The internal situation in Israel: a central shaper of Hamas's assessment; a restraining influence in the Gaza Strip and a multi-arena opportunity"
doc.\"בטווח הקצר, חמאס תופסת את ישראל כמסוכנ: "In the short term Hamas perceives Israel as more dangerous and less predictable, which constitutes a further factor in the movement's assessment restraining it from military action… For the Strip's leadership, the analysis of the risk in Israeli action is a further justification for the 'preserving the quiet' strategy the leadership espouses in any case…"
doc.\"באילו תנאים עלולה חמאס לזנוח את אסטרטג: "Under what conditions might Hamas abandon the 'preserving the quiet' strategy in the Strip and turn to intensifying friction with Israel?"
doc.מאז מבצע \"שומר החומות\" (מאי 2021) אימצ:
Since Operation Guardian of the Walls (May 2021) the Hamas leadership in the Gaza Strip has adopted a strategy whose purpose is to steer friction with Israel so that it remains below the threshold of direct military confrontation ("preserving the quiet"). This, while also seeking to avoid days of fighting with Israel and not only deterioration into a broad campaign (a matter of principle since Operation Protective Edge).
The "preserving the quiet" strategy is expressed chiefly in refraining from independent use of force from the Strip…
As we understand it, the "preserving the quiet" strategy has taken hold among the power players in the Strip, including senior figures of the military wing, and the Hamas leadership in the Strip believes it serves its needs at this time and improves its strategic balance…
As we understand it, this strategy has grown even stronger because of how the Strip's leadership views the implications of the internal situation in Israel. This stems mainly from perceiving Israel as less predictable at this time, and as liable to initiate a confrontation…
In our assessment, Hamas's strategy of preserving the quiet in the Strip is stable for the foreseeable future… Moreover, we identify no challenge to this strategy arising from a continuation of existing trends.
…It is more probable that a change in Hamas's strategy regarding the use of force from the Strip would occur gradually rather than by an initiated, one-off decision — certainly not by choice…
doc.מודיעין אוחר מלמד באופן חד משמעי שהתשובה: Later intelligence shows unequivocally that the answer to this is negative, and it gives a detailed explanation of why Hamas chose the timing at which the raid was carried out.
doc.ממודיעין שלל שהתקבל לאחר שפרצה המלחמה עו: Captured intelligence obtained after the war broke out indicates that in the summer of 2021, about three months after Operation Guardian of the Walls, a change of concept occurred in Hamas and a decision was taken to turn the idea of a broad above-ground raid into an operational order — 'Jericho Wall'. From that moment Hamas began conducting exercises and adjustments in force build-up with the aim of reaching full readiness to carry out the raid.
doc.עוד עולה ממודיעין זה, כי עד לקיץ 2021, ר: That intelligence further indicates that until the summer of 2021 the raid idea was neither a formed plan nor an operational order, but preliminary planning without operational ripeness; over the years, however, processes were carried out in force build-up and in Hamas's structure with the aim of improving the ability to realise the idea.
doc.במהלך שנת 2022 החלו תרגילים המדמים את הפ: During 2022 exercises simulating the raid itself began, including summoning operatives and allocating weaponry. In the course of 2022 dates within that year were proposed for carrying out the plan.
doc.במהלך שנת 2023 המשיכה חמאס לבצע אימונים: During 2023 Hamas continued to conduct training for carrying out the raid, until it was carried out on 7.10.
None of the above was brought to the Prime Minister’s knowledge.
doc.ראש הממשלה מעולם לא קיבל ולא עודכן על מס: The Prime Minister never received and was never briefed on the 'Jericho Wall' document. The fact that such a plan existed within Hamas was not presented to him, nor was he given any update on exercises simulating it. The opposite — he was told that Hamas had no ability to realise such an idea.
doc.במידה ומידע כזה היה מועבר, ברור כי ראש ה: Had such information been transmitted, it is clear that the Prime Minister would have directed preparation against this threat and its removal through initiated preventive measures and a different defensive posture around the Gaza envelope.
doc.גופי המודיעין התייחסו באופן קבוע לאיום ה: The intelligence bodies consistently treated the Hamas raid threat as a marginal component of Hamas's attack profile and determined that Hamas's ability to carry it out was limited to a small force of up to two companies, relying on tunnels to approach the fence. The security bodies further determined that the above-ground barrier, combined with intelligence means and the forces deployed in the sector, provided an optimal answer for warning of a raid and preventing it on the ground.
doc.ב-19 באפריל 2017 הופיע ראש הממשלה בפני ה: On 19 April 2017 the Prime Minister appeared before the Knesset State Control Committee and addressed Hamas's plans in Protective Edge as they had been presented to him. Following that information, already in 2016 the Prime Minister ordered the construction of the underground barrier in Gaza to block offensive tunnels. The barrier was indeed built and to date has not been breached.

The fire array — the principal damage potential

The defensive array — exacting a price from manoeuvring forces…"

Raid into Israeli territory
In general, we detect no significant change in the level of readiness (medium) on this matter relative to 2021… The wing continues to "suffer" from the same basic gaps, which it struggles to overcome: the absence of an effective operational answer to the Israeli barrier on the Strip's border; Israeli intelligence and operational superiority; and centralised command and control. This, in a way that reduces its ability to carry out such moves other than in complete surprise."

There is no mention at all of an above-ground raid. It should be recalled that at this stage Hamas already had a formed plan for a large-scale above-ground raid and had even examined executing it three times — a plan of which the Prime Minister was not informed.
